projects.title: Municipal Data Query Performance
bullets: Documented query plans for public municipal service tables in a supervised undergraduate capstone examining query performance.
Wrote SQL aggregation and join queries for public municipal service data using SQLite within the capstone project.

projects.title: Transit Timetable Database Queries
bullets: Loaded public transit timetable tables into a SQLite relational database as part of a supervised undergraduate team course project.
Wrote SQL aggregation and join queries and documented query plans for the course project's examination of query performance.

research.title: River Level Time Series Preparation
bullets: Aligned public river-level sensor time series and identified missing observations as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Implemented a seasonal baseline for forecasting from public environmental time series within the supervised research assignment.
